build.// no sitemap block: Deliberate. DocFX emitted one at /docs/sitemap.xml whose every URL was a 404: baseUrl was https://verifier.tessio.eu/api and DocFX appends its own api/ beneath that, giving /api/api/<Type>.html for pages that live at /docs/api/<Type>.html. It also duplicated work, because site/web/scripts/add-docs-to-sitemap.mjs walks the merged output and writes sitemap-docs.xml, which is the one robots.txt leads to. Two generators writing sitemaps for the same pages is how one drifts and nobody notices.

globalMetadata.// _appTitle: The SITE name, not a page description. DocFX renders <title>{page} | {_appTitle}</title>, so setting this to what the docs index page is already called produced 'Tessio.Verifier API reference | Tessio.Verifier API reference' on that one page.
